caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, featuring a hinged lid on top. The main body of the chest is a dark brown color, with two large front panels. Each front panel displays decorative patterns with stylized plants, stems, and flowers, mainly in muted tones of red, green, black, and beige, bordered by a faded red trim. Below the panels, there are two drawers, each with a brass-colored handle, separated by a vertical divider. The drawers have the same dark brown coloration as the rest of the chest, and show slight shading to indicate depth. The base of the chest has a molded edge and stands on bracket feet. The background of the drawing is plain and light, with a rectangular outline framing the composition. The artist's name, "FRANCIS BORELLI," is written in uppercase letters in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
